fusions.name: Stand for the Herd
fusions.desc: A spike thrust that deals 26 damage and leaves the target 12% easier to wound for 8 seconds. When it lands, your allies strike 20% harder for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Huddled Quills
fusions.desc: Bristles every quill on your body, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles. Its damage rises 10% for each ally near you (max +40%).

fusions.name: Between Them and Us
fusions.desc: A challenge that pulls up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Quilled Calf
fusions.desc: A bonded grazen calf with a back of quills fights beside you, butting an enemy within 3 tiles every 1.4 seconds. Each butt deals 3 damage and slows the target by 15% for 2 seconds.
